answer: Same 1/12° grid: yes (GLORYS12V1, daily means of uo/vo, 1993 onward). Same product: no — no hourly fields, no tides, no Stokes drift (Stokes from the 0.2° wave reanalysis instead). SMOC itself starts 2020-11-01, so it covers the 2021+ seasons. Past forecast runs are not in the catalogue: the archive is a best-analysis series.
